weather_report:
As dawn breaks over Downtown San Francisco, a gentle haze blankets the city, a soft reminder of the lingering marine layer that weaves through the early morning air. Currently, it feels cool, framed by a temperature in the upper fifties, as wisps of clouds drift lazily overhead, blending the silhouette of the cityscape into a muted palette. The west-southwest breeze carries the faint scent of salt, adding a crispness that energizes the senses.

As the day evolves, sunlight is poised to spill generously across the streets, ushering in a mostly sunny afternoon with temperatures inching towards the mid-sixties. The morning fog will gradually retreat, revealing vibrant vistas enhanced by the brightness of day. For those languishing in the comfort of home, it would be wise to embrace layers—perhaps a light jacket first thing, easily discarded as the warmth takes hold in the afternoon. The city beckons with simple pleasures; a stroll along the Embarcadero promises the soft glimmer of the bay and the laughter of passersby. Alternatively, a leisurely visit to a local café, sipping handcrafted coffee while watching the world dance into the light, would perfectly complement the serene transformation of the day.
